queries: WITH per_type AS (SELECT r.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN trader AS r ON t.trdref = r.tradereg GROUP BY r.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count::numeric) AS avg_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.trader_count, p.trader_count::numeric / totals.total_count AS share_of_total, p.trader_count - totals.avg_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND p.trader_count > totals.avg_count;
